The class `ManifestShortNameLength` in `lighthouse-core/audits/manifest-short-name-length.js` is directly responsible for auditing the length of the manifest's short name. The class `ManifestShortName` in `lighthouse-core/audits/manifest-short-name.js` is responsible for checking the presence of the short name in the manifest. Since the bug involves a missing short name, this class is relevant to ensure that the presence check is correctly implemented.

The function `parseShortName` in `lighthouse-core/lib/manifest-parser.js` is responsible for parsing the short name from the manifest. If the short name is missing, this function should handle it appropriately to prevent false positives.

The class `Manifest` in `lighthouse-core/gather/gatherers/manifest.js` is involved in fetching and parsing the manifest. It needs to ensure that the manifest data is correctly interpreted, especially when certain fields like the short name are missing.
